metadata.title: Travel and Countries Semantic Patterns
metadata.description: Semantic patterns for travel, countries, migration, and evaluative commentary reasoning.

concepts.title: Travel Reference
concepts.description: Literal mention of travel, trips, or movement between places.

concepts.title: Travel Destination
concepts.description: The destination, arrival point, or intended place of travel.

concepts.title: Travel Origin
concepts.description: The starting point or place of departure in a travel scene.

concepts.title: Travel Abroad
concepts.description: Travel outside the local country or region.

concepts.title: International Travel
concepts.description: Explicitly international movement, transit, or journeying.

concepts.title: Domestic Travel
concepts.description: Travel that stays inside the local country or region.

concepts.title: Border Crossing
concepts.description: Crossing a border, checkpoint, or immigration control point.

concepts.title: Airport
concepts.description: An airport, terminal, flight departure, or arrival setting.

concepts.title: Passport
concepts.description: Passport, identity travel document, or travel authorization mention.

concepts.title: Visa
concepts.description: Visa, entry permit, or travel authorization mention.

concepts.title: Foreign Country
concepts.description: Mention of a country outside the speaker's current home context.

concepts.title: Foreign City
concepts.description: Mention of a city outside the speaker's current home context.

concepts.title: Foreign Government Reference
concepts.description: A reference to a foreign government, ministry, or state authority.

concepts.title: Foreign People
concepts.description: References to people from another country or region.

concepts.title: Foreign Culture
concepts.description: References to another country's culture, customs, or social life.

concepts.title: Foreign Religion
concepts.description: References to religious life in another country or region.

concepts.title: Foreign Customs
concepts.description: References to another country's customs, traditions, or habits.

concepts.title: Foreign Landmarks
concepts.description: References to landmarks, monuments, or notable places abroad.

concepts.title: Foreign Language
concepts.description: References to another language or language learning abroad.

concepts.title: Foreign Food
concepts.description: References to cuisine, food, or dining in another country.

concepts.title: Foreign Event
concepts.description: References to events, festivals, or occasions abroad.

concepts.title: Foreign Media
concepts.description: References to foreign press, television, or media coverage.

concepts.title: Foreign Law
concepts.description: References to legal rules, law, or regulation in another country.

concepts.title: Foreign Police
concepts.description: References to police, law enforcement, or public order abroad.

concepts.title: Foreign Military
concepts.description: References to the military or armed forces of another country.

concepts.title: Tourism
concepts.description: Tourism, travel services, sightseeing, or visitor activity.

concepts.title: Immigration
concepts.description: Movement into a country for residence or settlement.

concepts.title: Emigration
concepts.description: Movement out of a country or region.

concepts.title: Refugee
concepts.description: A person displaced by conflict, persecution, or forced movement.

concepts.title: Exile
concepts.description: Forced or self-imposed removal from one's home country.

concepts.title: Deportation
concepts.description: Formal removal from a country or enforced expulsion.

concepts.title: International Business
concepts.description: Business, trade, or commerce across borders.

concepts.title: International Study
concepts.description: Study, training, or education abroad.

concepts.title: Medical Travel
concepts.description: Travel for treatment, recovery, or healthcare.

concepts.title: Religious Travel
concepts.description: Travel for pilgrimage, worship, or religious duties.

concepts.title: Historical Travel
concepts.description: Historical journeys, migration history, or travel in a historical frame.

concepts.title: Fictional Travel
concepts.description: Travel presented within fiction, fantasy, or invented narrative.

concepts.title: Dream Travel
concepts.description: Travel occurring inside a dream or dreamlike frame.

concepts.title: Flashback Travel
concepts.description: Travel recalled in flashback or remembered past sequence.

concepts.title: Imaginary Country
concepts.description: A country invented by fiction, fantasy, or imagination.

concepts.title: Travel Scene Description
concepts.description: Visual or textual description of a travel scene, location, or movement.

concepts.title: Travel Dialogue
concepts.description: Dialogue in which travel, movement, or destination is discussed.

concepts.title: Travel Observation
concepts.description: Neutral observation of travel details without evaluation or allegation.

concepts.title: Country Comparison
concepts.description: Comparative commentary between countries, places, or travel destinations.

concepts.title: Country Insult
concepts.description: Derogatory language aimed at a country, nation, or its people.

concepts.title: Country Praise
concepts.description: Positive evaluative language about a country, nation, or its people.

concepts.title: Country Mockery
concepts.description: Mocking or ridiculing a country, nation, or its people.

concepts.title: Country Stereotype
concepts.description: Stereotyping language about a country or its population.

concepts.title: Country Security Reference
concepts.description: Security, safety, or control references tied to a country or nation.

concepts.title: Country Political Reference
concepts.description: Political references, governance talk, or state critique about a country.

entries.title: Travel Reference
indirect_expressions: The line is about travel rather than violation.
false_positives: Treating a destination mention as criticism or political speech.
counter_examples: A simple travel note that describes movement without judgement.
cross_sentence_indicators: A later sentence clarifies the destination or travel intent.
reviewer_guidance: Use travel observation and country reference reasoning before deciding whether this is a finding.
Do not over-trigger on a neutral travel note or a place name without context.

confidence_modifiers.title: Direct Signal
confidence_modifiers.description: The line explicitly states the travel or country meaning.

confidence_modifiers.title: Contextual Signal
confidence_modifiers.description: The surrounding scene helps confirm the travel or country meaning.

glossary_relationships.note: Travel reference is the umbrella anchor for this concept.

gcam_mappings.note: Use for factual travel mention, observation, or neutral country reference.
